posts.headline: Seven straight editions of torching One Nut Barner and Put it in Ra with a 20-8, back-to-back-top-2, zero-ring resume, and if tonight's draft board doesn't scream desperation, I'm retiring the bit — but don't count on it.
posts.detail: Adam Barner has heard it for a week now and hasn't said a word back; a resume this gaudy with a 1.5 average finish and no rings has one job tonight: stop being almost.

posts.headline: Eight editions of Big Head slander later, Sasinci's World finally has to draft instead of talk, and a losing 13-15 career mark says the ring is starting to look like a rumor.
posts.detail: Alxgalvn's crew carries a title but a 5.5 average finish and a losing record — Milk Man can sing whatever he wants, the roster has to answer tonight.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh has now gone eight editions without a peep, and a dead-last 4-10, 12th-place finish doesn't get buried by silence — it gets confirmed by it.
posts.detail: The untalented tenth lives up to the irony every single day this preseason continues without a single word of self-defense from Chauncey.

posts.headline: The Thicks keeps getting told the ring might be a mirage and keeps saying nothing — #FreeMaxx Champions better draft like they believe their own hype, because a 14-14 career record isn't buying any more benefit of the doubt.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 is 2-for-2 seasons of respectable-but-not-dominant ball with one title and an 8th-place worst finish on record — this draft is where we find out if last year was destiny or luck.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way heads into the draft off a rock-bottom 10th-place debut, and nothing about the silence from Pharaoh23 suggests this year breaks the pattern.
posts.detail: A 6-8 record dressed up as respectable masked a 10th-place finish — bottom-feeder pedigree doesn't get fixed by picking a name, it gets fixed by picking players, and the track record says don't hold your breath.
